attribution.role: ARCH-001 author and ARCH-002 preregistration drafter; prior context disclosed, not independent-person replication

evidence.scope: Canonical H03 grouping/cost and H05 Boolean-equivalence context; no renamed identities or physical claims.
Preserve bounded negative software arithmetic results; no arithmetic rerun or interpretation as a universal hardware result.

uncertainty: No equivalent completed two-array equality-count study found in inspected tracked main/Commons/related PR scope. No claim about unpublished branches. Correctness and host/comparator/statistical qualification are outstanding; no kernels, oracle corpus, pilot or performance execution occurred. Parametric confidence and joint-power targets are conditional on independent approximately normal log ratios.

human_authorization.record: Current user authorizes documentation-only protocol and a narrowly scoped draft PR if coherent/nonduplicative. Subsequent correctness-only implementation/execution and all performance work remain separately unauthorized.

research_question: For C=sum_i[a_i=b_i] on immutable {-1,0,+1} arrays, can a checked T81 C2 implementation reduce qualified M2 end-to-end cost against a separately pilot-selected optimized conventional control? Supporting H03/H05 discriminator, not ternary-exclusive superiority.
falsification_criterion: STOP on equivalent accepted prior evidence. Any wrong count/admission/padding or ineffective Release control fails correctness. Missing strong controls blocks timing. All four simultaneous lower log-ratio bounds must exceed ln(10/9) for the scoped 10%-lower-latency claim; otherwise classify threshold not supported or inconclusive as PROTOCOL section 7 specifies. No density/resident-only/physical generalization.
matched_control: B-BYTE native SIMD/auto-vectorized equality and widening count; B-PLANES positive/negative mask plus population count; independent same-byte B-C2; B-PT5 group-LUT count. Identical logical inputs/statuses and total end-to-end cost. Fixed candidate, pilot-separated control selection and disjoint confirmatory seeds.
method: PROTOCOL.md sections 1-8 are the complete experimental contract. Strict experimental adapters, independent scalar and histogram oracles, exhaustive N<=5 symbol pairs, boundaries/invalids and deterministic SplitMix64 vectors. Documentation now; future correctness-only gate must precede separate host/comparator/statistics approval and performance authorization.
measurement_plan: Design only: N=2^20,2^24 x uniform/skewed = four endpoints; end-to-end mean paired log(TB/TC); theta0=ln(10/9), planning alternative ln(1.25). Frozen 8-block selection, 16-block variance pilot, common n=20..64 via noncentral-t power >=.975 per endpoint to target >=.90 joint power conditional on the model. Four two-sided 98.75% t intervals give >=.95 simultaneous coverage. Exact rules/seeds/caps in PROTOCOL; no optional stopping or outlier deletion. Resident mode descriptive and separately scheduled/authorized.
expected_artifacts: Reviewed source/host/comparator/statistical qualification records and explicit authorization boundaries
Canonical decoder/oracle/candidate identities, frozen dual-oracle expectations and complete correctness results including intentional wrong-result and suppressed-check controls
Exact regenerable seed/input hashes, output counts/statuses, source/binary hashes and cap/host events
Separately authorized calibration/pilot/confirmation raw block data and frozen selection/sample-size receipt, only if later approved
All failures/inconclusive outcomes with no overwritten historical evidence
resource_requirements: Future authorized campaign: one process and worker thread; <=512 MiB additional resident memory; <=30 minutes elapsed including setup/oracle/warmup/analysis; <=100 MiB retained evidence.
Known target: user-specified 2022 M2 MacBook Air 8 GB RAM/256 GB SSD; modeled working buffers <300 MiB, actual qualification outstanding; no swap-dependent or SSD-bound timings.
Jules Linux is UNKNOWN until characterized; no pooled/native M2 inference from it, QEMU or a container.
security_requirements: Documentation-only current change. No ISA-002, VM, Axion, compiler, governance, frozen CPA or historical-results modifications; no merge.
Standalone future adapters impose experimental strict validation without changing production encoding contracts. No expected-count or pair metadata supplied to kernels.
Correctness-only implementation/execution and all pilots/benchmarks need separate explicit commit-scoped authorization. No PR/JSON status grants that authorization.
